render: For each profile, emit dist/opencode/agents/autonomous/<name>.md carrying the profile's `mode`, `steps`, and `permissions` frontmatter plus the matching neutral task-contract body copied from skills/work/references/tasks/<role>.md (implement and implement-hard both use implement.md). The model/effort for that route is taken from the resolved routing at build time: an explicit route writes a `model:` line (and reasoning effort) into the rendered profile frontmatter, while an inherit route omits the `model:` line so the profile inherits the session model. There are seven profiles, one per routing key; implement-hard is a distinct profile so its harder route is not silently dropped.

profiles.name: explore
profiles.description: Focused reconnaissance of project or external source for one tightly scoped question.

profiles.name: implement
profiles.description: Implements one small, verifiable implementation slice.

profiles.name: implement-hard
profiles.description: Implements one reasoning-heavy implementation slice (hard-task routing context).

profiles.name: fix
profiles.description: Addresses only the specified review findings in a fix pass.

profiles.name: review
profiles.description: Independent high-reasoning review of one completed implementation slice.

profiles.name: deep-review
profiles.description: Expensive, integration-level audit of several accepted implementation slices.

profiles.name: consult
profiles.description: Independent second opinion on one stuck technical decision; read-only, returns one recommendation.
